article.story: MARTIN, Tenn. -- — Reid Conley’s 22 points helped UT Martin defeat Ecclesia 128-44 on Sunday. Conley shot 10 for 13, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc for the Skyhawks (3-2). Nikola Janicic scored 21 points, shooting 8 for 10, including 5 for 7 from beyond the arc. Ousseynou Sambe had 17 points and shot 6 of 9 from the field and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line. Jordan Abram finished with 18 points for the Royals. Ecclesia, a member of the National Christian College Athletic Association (NCCAA), also got five points from Jayden Blair. Gabe Davis finished with five points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
